compat_description: Compare two birth charts with this free BaZi Compatibility Calculator. See how the Day Pillars and five elements affect the score. Birth times are optional.
compat_intro: Enter both people’s birth details and select “I don’t know my birth time” where needed. Open the score breakdown to see how the Day Pillars relate and how much of each person’s favorable elements appears in the other chart.
compat_partner_note: The free calculator uses the other person’s birth details only for this result and does not save them by default. If you buy a full reading, the details are saved with the report and deleted when you delete it. Please ask before entering someone else’s details.
compat_desc_score: The table below shows what each traditional rule adds to or subtracts from the starting score of {base}. The final score falls between 0 and 100 and is for reference only.
compat_desc_pillars: The calculation uses each person’s Day Pillar and the balance of the five elements in their chart.
compat_breakdown: See how the score adds up
compat_item_branch_triad: Day Branches in the same three-harmony group
compat_item_element_complement_ab: Your favorable elements in their chart
compat_item_element_complement_ba: Their favorable elements in your chart
compat_unknown_time: {person}: with no birth time entered, this chart uses the year, month and day pillars. The element comparison uses weighted shares from those three pillars.
compat_shared_note: This shared result shows the reference score and chart relationships without either person’s birth details. Enter the birth details to run the calculation again.
compat_unlock_partner_note: If you buy a full reading, the birth details used to generate it are stored with the report. Deleting the report also deletes those details.
compat_faq_q1: What adds to or subtracts from the BaZi compatibility score?
compat_faq_a1: Open the breakdown to see how the total changes from 60 points. A combination between the Day Masters earns 15 points. For the Day Branches, six harmony earns 12 points and two different branches in the same three-harmony group earn 8. A clash costs 15 points and a punishment costs 8. Each chart can contribute up to 10 more points based on the weighted share of the other person’s favorable elements.
compat_faq_q2: What can I take away from the score?
compat_faq_a2: Use the breakdown to see which chart relationships contributed to the score. A low number tells you nothing about how you get along. Use the result for reference and self-reflection only. It does not predict the future.
compat_items_title: How to read the seven items
compat_items_desc: The reference score comes only from these seven items. Once you have a result, read the notes for the items that added or subtracted points.
compat_desc_reading: Only the items that changed the score are listed, with notes written for the relationship you chose.
